summary: fastify-bundler fetches and executes attacker-controlled JavaScript from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package advertises itself as a Fastify-style web framework but contains no framework code. Its exported getPlugin function fetches JSON from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at https://46.183.25.232:45000/icons/105 and passes the response's `credits` field to `new Function(...)`, executing arbitrary attacker-supplied JavaScript inside the installer's Node.js process with access to `require`, `process`, and full runtime privileges. The dependency set (@primno/dpapi for Windows DPAPI decryption, better-sqlite3 for reading browser cookie/login databases, node-machine-id for host fingerprinting) matches an infostealer loader shape. The package name and description impersonate the Fastify project, but its only functional behavior is remote code retrieval and execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
